+		out, err := expr.Run(program, env)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, "bar", out)
+	})
+	t.Run("env map", func(t *testing.T) {
+		program, err := expr.Compile(`m[ptr]`, expr.Env(env))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		out, err := expr.Run(program, env)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, 9, out)
+	})
+	t.Run("nil pointer key yields zero value", func(t *testing.T) {
+		program, err := expr.Compile(`m[nilPtr]`, expr.Env(env))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		out, err := expr.Run(program, env)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, 0, out)
+	})
+	t.Run("pointer-keyed map is not dereferenced", func(t *testing.T) {
+		program, err := expr.Compile(`ptrKeys[ptr]`, expr.Env(env))
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+
+		out, err := expr.Run(program, env)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.Equal(t, 7, out)
+	})

+func TestDeref_conditional(t *testing.T) {
+	ok := true
+	f := false
+	var nilBool *bool
+	env := map[string]any{
+		"ok":      &ok,
+		"f":       &f,
+		"nilBool": nilBool,
+	}
+

+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	out, err := expr.Run(program, env)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, out)
+
+	program, err = expr.Compile(`f ? 1 : 0`, expr.Env(env))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	out, err = expr.Run(program, env)

+package deref_test
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestDeref_map_key_pointer(t *testing.T) {
+	s := "foo"
+	env := map[string]any{"ptr": &s}
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`{foo: "bar"}[ptr]`, env)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "bar", out)
+}
+
+func TestDeref_cond_pointer(t *testing.T) {
+	b := true
+	env := map[string]any{"ptr": &b}
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`ptr ? 1 : 0`, env)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 1, out)
+	f := false
+	out, err = expr.Eval(`ptr ? 1 : 0`, map[string]any{"ptr": &f})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 0, out)
+}
+
+func TestDeref_array_index_pointer(t *testing.T) {
+	i := 1
+	out, err := expr.Eval(`[10, 20][ptr]`, map[string]any{"ptr": &i})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 20, out)
+}
+
+func TestDeref_typed_env_map_key_and_cond(t *testing.T) {
+	s := "foo"
+	b := true
+	i := 1
+	env := map[string]any{"str": &s, "flag": &b, "idx": &i}
+	for code, want := range map[string]any{
+		`{foo: "bar"}[str]`:   "bar",
+		`flag ? 1 : 0`:        1,
+		`[10, 20][idx]`:       20,
+		`{foo: "bar"}?.[str]`: "bar",
+	} {
+		p, err := expr.Compile(code, expr.Env(env))
+		require.NoError(t, err, code)
+		out, err := expr.Run(p, env)
+		require.NoError(t, err, code)
+		require.Equal(t, want, out, code)
+	}
+}

+package patcher_test
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr"
+	"github.com/expr-lang/expr/internal/testify/require"
+)
+
+type withContextNestedEnv struct {
+	Ctx context.Context `expr:"ctx"`
+}
+
+func TestWithContext_two_patched_calls_in_one_call(t *testing.T) {
+	program, err := expr.Compile(
+		`now2().After(date2())`,
+		expr.Env(withContextNestedEnv{}),
+		expr.WithContext("ctx"),
+		expr.Function(
+			"now2",
+			func(params ...any) (any, error) {
+				require.NotNil(t, params[0].(context.Context))
+				return time.Now(), nil
+			},
+			new(func(context.Context) time.Time),
+		),
+		expr.Function(
+			"date2",
+			func(params ...any) (any, error) {
+				require.NotNil(t, params[0].(context.Context))
+				return time.Date(2000, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), nil
+			},
+			new(func(context.Context) time.Time),
+		),
+	)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	output, err := expr.Run(program, &withContextNestedEnv{Ctx: context.Background()})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, true, output)
+}
+
+func TestWithContext_nested_patched_calls_as_arguments(t *testing.T) {
+	env := map[string]any{
+		"ctx": context.Background(),
+		"add": func(ctx context.Context, a, b int) int { return a + b },
+		"one": func(ctx context.Context) int { return 1 },
+	}
+	program, err := expr.Compile(`add(add(one(), one()), one())`, expr.Env(env), expr.WithContext("ctx"))
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	output, err := expr.Run(program, env)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 3, output)
+}
